newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 recovers to finish higher after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 recovers to finish higher after U.S. data.

text.p: Leading British shares closed higher for a third successive day on Friday, rebounding from early U.S.-led weakness and extending gains on relief that U.S. employment data had turned up few surprises about inflationary pressures.
The FTSE 100 index finished up 5.8 points at 3,893.0 points and gainers outweighed losers by around five to four.
Leading shares rallied almost 40-points to the day's best levels following a short dip after the U.S. data which had kept markets on tenterhooks all week.
"Everyone was so keyed up that this report was always going to be a bit of an anti-climax," one trader said.
